subject: sentences
title: The right little word
about: Filling the blank with the right small word: he, she, it, they, we, his, her; a or an; is, are or am. CKLA Unit 6 matches pronouns to nouns and Unit 7 does noun-verb agreement, all on the NC K-1 grammar continuum.
tip: Have him read the whole sentence out loud with his choice in it and ask whether it sounds right.

cards.q: Pick the word: Sam is a boy. ___ has a hat.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Sam is a boy. blank has a hat.
cards.note: Sam is a boy, so we say he. He is for a boy or a man.

cards.q: Pick the word: Jen is a girl. ___ likes to swim.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Jen is a girl. blank likes to swim.
cards.note: Jen is a girl, so we say she. She is for a girl or a woman.

cards.q: Pick the word: The cup is red. ___ is on the table.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The cup is red. blank is on the table.
cards.note: A cup is a thing, not a person, so we say it. It is for a thing.

cards.q: Pick the word: Sam and Pam are twins. ___ are six.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Sam and Pam are twins. blank are six.
cards.note: Sam and Pam are two people. They is for more than one.

cards.q: Pick the word: The dogs are wet. ___ swam in the pond.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The dogs are wet. blank swam in the pond.
cards.note: More than one dog, so we say they. It would be for just one thing.

cards.q: Pick the word: Pam has a hat. It is ___ hat.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Pam has a hat. It is blank hat.
cards.note: Pam is a girl, so the hat is her hat. His is for a boy.

cards.q: Pick the word: Ben has a bike. It is ___ bike.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Ben has a bike. It is blank bike.
cards.note: Ben is a boy, so the bike is his bike. Her is for a girl.

cards.q: Pick the word: Mom and I like cake. ___ eat it on Sunday.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Mom and I like cake. blank eat it on Sunday.
cards.note: Mom and I together are we. We means me and someone else.

cards.q: Which is right for the egg?
cards.note: Use an before a word that starts with a vowel sound: an egg, an apple. Cup does not, so it is a cup.

cards.q: Which is right for the cat?
cards.note: Cat starts with a consonant sound, so we say a cat. Owl starts with a vowel sound, so it is an owl.

cards.q: Which is right for the apple?
cards.note: Use an before a word that starts with a vowel sound: an egg, an apple. Pig does not, so it is a pig.

cards.q: Which is right for the bus?
cards.note: Bus starts with a consonant sound, so we say a bus. Ant starts with a vowel sound, so it is an ant.

cards.q: Pick the word: The dogs ___ big.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The dogs blank big.
cards.note: More than one dog, so we say are. One thing is; more than one are; I am.

cards.q: Pick the word: The cat ___ soft.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The cat blank soft.
cards.note: Just one cat, so we say is. One thing is; more than one are; I am.

cards.q: Pick the word: Sam and Pam ___ at the park.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Sam and Pam blank at the park.
cards.note: Sam and Pam are two people, so we say are. More than one are.

cards.sayQ: Pick the word: I blank six.
cards.note: The word I always goes with am: I am six.
